description: This file defines the class NullFeatures, representing an immutable, null-object implementation of the Features interface in the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides default or no-op implementations for feature-related methods, indicating the absence of features.

classes.name: NullFeatures
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the Features interface, representing a feature set with no features (null object pattern).

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of NullFeatures representing a null set of features.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional indicating no feature with the specified ID exists.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Returns a new Features instance containing the specified feature.

methods.name: removeFeature
methods.description: Returns itself, as removal has no effect on a null feature set.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Returns itself after attempting to set a feature definition, with no actual effect.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Returns itself, as there is nothing to remove.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Returns itself after attempting to set properties on a feature.

methods.name: removeProperties
methods.description: Returns itself, as there are no properties to remove.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Returns itself after attempting to set a property, with no effect.

methods.name: removeProperty
methods.description: Returns itself, as there are no properties to remove.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Returns true, indicating this features object represents a null feature set.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns 0, indicating no features are present.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns an empty stream of features.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Returns a JSON object representing null features.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Provides a hash code for the NullFeatures class.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on class type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
